description: Single halo: a centre stone plus sixteen stones on a 3.4mm ring at 0.22 scale.
knownLimitations: HALO_METAL_ABSENT: a stone solid is built for every halo stone, but no metal is generated to hold them. A setting is built only for the primary stone; the halo stones are placed reference geometry.
notes: Sprint 25 Halo System v1: INITIAL_BASELINE for a newly executable halo variant or composition. Created by running the real pipeline; no existing baseline was modified.
